I’m a Pathologist. Retatrutide is NOT Ozempic. It’s Biological Overdrive.

Imagine a molecule so powerful it doesn't just silence your hunger, it can "power-wash" 80% of the fat out of your liver in a matter of months (based on the studies published). We’ve seen Ozempic as a GLP-1 agonist and Mounjaro as a dual GLP/GIP receptor agonist. But while the world was distracted by the side effects of the first generation, a "Triple-Agonist" was being engineered. It’s called Retatrutide.

In this video, I’m tallying the "biological price tag" of Retatrutide that often stays buried in the medical literature. As a Triple Board-Certified Physician, Pathologist, I’ve spent the last few weeks dismantling the TRIUMPH Phase 3 clinical data to separate the marketing noise from the cellular reality. We explore the "Glucagon Paradox," the risk of heart redlining (tachycardia), muscle wasting (sarcopenia), and how to actively mitigate these risks if you and your doctor decide this is the right path for you.
